description: A logged-in user can edit and save their profile information from the profile page.
testSteps:
1. User is logged in and on the profile page
2. User clicks the Edit Profile button
3. The edit form appears with current values pre-filled
4. User clears and updates the name field
5. User clears and updates the phone number field
6. User clicks Save Changes
7. A success message 'Profile updated' is shown
8. The profile page now displays the updated name and phone number
9. User tries to save with an empty name field
10. A validation error 'Name is required' is shown
componentDescription: EditProfileForm component with: name input (pre-filled), email input (read-only), phone input (pre-filled), Save Changes button, Cancel button, success message area, validation error messages per field
